run_evaluate_l2l_optimizer: run the evaluate module with L2L optimizer to train a meta-optimizer network on a simple problem
run_evaluate_adam_optimizer: run the evaluate module with Adam optimizer to train a problem network using standard gradient descent
run_evaluate_with_config: run the evaluate module with custom problem type, number of epochs, and learning rate settings
run_evaluate_with_seed: run the evaluate module with a fixed random seed for reproducible evaluation results
run_evaluate_with_saved_path: run the evaluate module using a saved meta-optimizer network from a given checkpoint path
